small.delay_status: Conservative model delay/ramp; exact installation switching time must be measured

counterbalance.material: Proposed EN 10270-1 spring steel; grade, hook form, initial tension and fatigue life require spring supplier review
counterbalance.model: Two tension-only Hookean springs between the actual moving anchor coordinates; no ideal constant torque
counterbalance.installation: Compact pinned short-lever layout with actual BREP brackets; preload, spring fatigue and guarded installation still require qualification

gripper_driver.control: PH/EN; PWM with synchronized current sampling; independent hardware chopping ceiling; fault latches; VREF low by default

gripper_cable.note: Corrected: 4mm jacket + two 0.5mm liner walls requires 5mm hardware bore.

assumptions: Brake stator/armature split and interfaces are engineering envelopes, not vendor native CAD.
Brake torque/time/energy model is a screening model, not safety certification.
Cable routing is a nominal route with strain-relief geometry, not a flex-life qualification.
Spring winding/hook geometry and thermal motor constants require measured qualification.

elbow_counterbalance.material: Proposed spring steel; exact grade, initial tension, hook form and fatigue life require spring supplier qualification
elbow_counterbalance.model: Two tension-only springs at actual moving anchors. Reaction is represented by joint-3 generalized torque, not external support.
elbow_counterbalance.installation: Compact pinned short-lever layout with actual BREP brackets; preload, spring fatigue and guarded installation still require qualification

design_decisions: Retain finite 22Nm/2.2Nm static brake selection; dynamic braking remains an explicitly derated screening assumption.
Add a real 6Nm-reference elbow spring pair after doubled-delay fault tests showed approximately 10 degrees elbow travel without it.
Do not treat low catalog switching work as proof of acceptable stop distance.
Use nominal spring torque in control feedforward while plant strength varies; weak-spring testing no longer assumes perfect knowledge of deterioration.

P5 corrects inherited hard stops after exact native collision checks: J3 upper stop1.85rad, J5 upper stop1.63rad; soft maxima1.83/1.61rad. Coupled configurations still require collision-aware planning.

qualifications: Ring shape is installed envelope, not free-state supplier geometry.
Inner-race endplay must be measured and shim thickness selected; no unverified preload.
The specified root blend is not a claim of hob-generated trochoidal geometry.
D-flat nominal size is manufacturer-documented; tolerance, runout, clamping and inspection remain release gates.

folded_transmission.architecture: Parallel-axis folded motor/reducer with actual 1:1 toothed belt, bolted deck, slotted gearbox carriage and removable belt cover. Full original motor/reducer envelope sizes preserved.
folded_transmission.tooth_geometry_status: Nominal rounded tooth/groove screening geometry with explicit clearance, not a manufacturing-certified HTD cutter profile. Supplier belt tension and torque rating required.

rating_screen.qualification: Catalog screening at lowest tabulated speed; low-speed extrapolation, custom tooth shape, pretension, alignment, fatigue and supplier approval remain unqualified.

bench_interface.mount_fasteners: Six nominal M8 through-bolts, retaining nuts and individual Ø28 mm steel backing washers; bench strength not qualified.
